name: 1-2-4-All
deliverable: Progressive silent reflection, paired synthesis, quartet convergence

steps.text: Pose one question worth the room's attention, then give everyone sixty seconds of silent writing before any talking starts.
Pair people where they sit and give them two minutes to compare notes and agree on the most urgent shared point.
Merge pairs into fours for four minutes; ask them to name the patterns and reduce to one idea the whole room needs.
Harvest in plenary without a round robin: ask who can add a theme not yet heard, and keep taking only new material.

failure: The silent minute turns into chatter, the loudest voice frames the pair, and the plenary becomes a sequence of similar reports.
intervention: Restart the timer and say the first minute is solo: "When we talk early, the quickest voice sets the frame and the room stops thinking."
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.title: The Surprising Power of Liberating Structures
